9	/-!
10	# Affine two-chart covers, and their pullback along the base-change projection
11	
12	An **affine two-chart cover** of a scheme `Y` (`Scheme.AffineTwoCover`) is a pair of affine
13	opens `V₀, V₁` covering `Y` whose overlap `V₀ ⊓ V₁` is again affine. This file provides:
14	
15	* the structure `Scheme.AffineTwoCover`;
16	* **existence** for the challenge curve: the smooth, proper, geometrically irreducible curve
17	  `C/k` admits an affine two-chart cover (`Scheme.AffineTwoCover.nonempty_of_curve`), obtained
18	  as the preimages of the two standard charts of `ℙ¹` under a finite `k`-morphism `C ⟶ ℙ¹`
19	  (`exists_isFinite_toP1`, `AlgebraicJacobian.Curve.MapToP1`); the overlap is affine because it
20	  is the preimage of the affine chart overlap `D₊(X₀X₁)`;
21	* **stability under base change**: an affine two-chart cover of `C.left` pulls back, along the
22	  first projection `(C ⊗ overSpec k R).left ⟶ C.left`, to an affine two-chart cover of
23	  `(C ⊗ overSpec k R).left`, for any `k`-algebra `R` (`Scheme.AffineTwoCover.pullbackProd`).
24	  The key input is that the first projection is an affine morphism: it is the base change of
25	  `overSpec k R ⟶ Spec k` (itself affine, being a morphism between affine schemes) along
26	  `C.hom` (`Over.isAffineHom_fst_left`), and preimages of affine opens under an affine
27	  morphism are affine.
28	
29	## Main declarations
30	
31	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.AffineTwoCover` — the structure.
32	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.AffineTwoCover.nonempty_of_curve` — existence for the curve.
33	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.isAffineHom_fst_left` — the first projection of a base change along
34	  an affine morphism is affine.
35	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.AffineTwoCover.pullbackProd` — the pullback of an affine two-chart
36	  cover along the first projection `(C ⊗ overSpec k R).left ⟶ C.left`.
37	-/

39	set_option autoImplicit false

47	/-! ## The structure -/
48	
49	/-- An **affine two-chart cover** of a scheme `Y`: two affine opens `V₀, V₁` covering `Y`
50	whose overlap `V₀ ⊓ V₁` is again affine. -/
51	structure Scheme.AffineTwoCover (Y : Scheme.{u}) : Type u where
52	  /-- The first chart. -/
53	  V₀ : Y.Opens
54	  /-- The second chart. -/
55	  V₁ : Y.Opens
56	  /-- The first chart is affine. -/
57	  isAffineOpen₀ : IsAffineOpen V₀
58	  /-- The second chart is affine. -/
59	  isAffineOpen₁ : IsAffineOpen V₁
60	  /-- The two charts cover `Y`. -/
61	  sup_eq_top : V₀ ⊔ V₁ = ⊤
62	  /-- The overlap of the two charts is affine. -/
63	  isAffineOpen_inf : IsAffineOpen (V₀ ⊓ V₁)
64	
65	/-- The overlap of the two charts of an affine two-chart cover is contained in the first
66	chart. -/
67	theorem Scheme.AffineTwoCover.inf_le_left {Y : Scheme.{u}} (D : Y.AffineTwoCover) :
68	    D.V₀ ⊓ D.V₁ ≤ D.V₀ :=
69	  _root_.inf_le_left
70	
71	/-- The overlap of the two charts of an affine two-chart cover is contained in the second
72	chart. -/
73	theorem Scheme.AffineTwoCover.inf_le_right {Y : Scheme.{u}} (D : Y.AffineTwoCover) :
74	    D.V₀ ⊓ D.V₁ ≤ D.V₁ :=
75	  _root_.inf_le_right
76	
77	/-! ## Existence: the two chart preimages of a finite map to the projective line -/
78	
79	section Existence
80	
81	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
82	  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
83	
84	/-- **Existence of an affine two-chart cover of the curve**: the smooth, proper,
85	geometrically irreducible curve `C/k` admits an affine two-chart cover, obtained as the
86	preimages of the two standard charts of `ℙ¹` under a finite `k`-morphism `C ⟶ ℙ¹`
87	(`exists_isFinite_toP1`). The charts are affine and cover `C.left`
88	(`isAffineOpen_preimage_chartOpen`, `preimage_chartOpen_sup`); the overlap is affine because
89	it is the preimage of the affine chart overlap `D₊(X₀X₁)` (`P1.isAffineOpen_overlap`), via
90	`P1.chartOpen_inf` and preimage commuting with `⊓`. -/
91	theorem Scheme.AffineTwoCover.nonempty_of_curve : Nonempty C.left.AffineTwoCover := by
92	  obtain ⟨π, hfin, -⟩ := exists_isFinite_toP1 (C := C)
93	  haveI := hfin
94	  -- restated with the ambient scheme literally `P1 k` (as `P1.chartOpen` is stated), so that
95	  -- `.preimage π` below unifies against `π : C.left ⟶ P1 k` without unfolding `P1`.
96	  have hinf : IsAffineOpen (P1.chartOpen k 0 ⊓ P1.chartOpen k 1) := by
97	    rw [P1.chartOpen_inf k]
98	    exact P1.isAffineOpen_overlap k
99	  refine ⟨{ V₀ := π ⁻¹ᵁ P1.chartOpen k 0
100	            V₁ := π ⁻¹ᵁ P1.chartOpen k 1
101	            isAffineOpen₀ := isAffineOpen_preimage_chartOpen π 0
102	            isAffineOpen₁ := isAffineOpen_preimage_chartOpen π 1
103	            sup_eq_top := preimage_chartOpen_sup π
104	            isAffineOpen_inf := ?_ }⟩
105	  rw [← Scheme.Hom.preimage_inf]
106	  exact hinf.preimage π
107	
108	end Existence
109	
110	/-! ## Pullback along the base-change projection -/
111	
112	/-- **The first projection of a base change along an affine morphism is affine**: for `X, T`
113	objects of `Over S`, `(fst X T).left` is (up to the defeq `Over.fst_left`/`Over.tensorObj_left`)
114	the pullback of `T.hom` along `X.hom`, i.e. `Limits.pullback.fst X.hom T.hom`
115	(`Over.isPullback_left`, flipped so that the affine leg `T.hom` lines up with the class field
116	`IsStableUnderBaseChange.of_isPullback`); affineness is stable under base change
117	(`isAffineHom_isStableUnderBaseChange`). -/
118	instance Over.isAffineHom_fst_left {S : Scheme.{u}} (X T : Over S) [IsAffineHom T.hom] :
119	    IsAffineHom (fst X T).left :=
120	  MorphismProperty.of_isPullback (P := @IsAffineHom) (Over.isPullback_left X T).flip ‹_›
121	
122	/-- The underlying scheme of `overSpec k A` is affine (restated from `overSpec_left`, which
123	identifies it with `Spec (.of A)`, so that instance search finds it without unfolding the
124	`abbrev overSpec`). -/
125	instance isAffine_overSpec_left {k : Type u} [Field k] {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
126	    [Algebra k A] : IsAffine (overSpec k A).left := by
127	  rw [overSpec_left]; infer_instance
128	
129	/-- The structure morphism `overSpec k A ⟶ Spec k` is affine: it is a morphism between affine
130	schemes. -/
131	instance isAffineHom_overSpec_hom {k : Type u} [Field k] {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
132	    [Algebra k A] : IsAffineHom (overSpec k A).hom :=
133	  isAffineHom_of_isAffine _
134	
135	section PullbackProd
136	
137	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
138	
139	/-- **Base change of an affine two-chart cover**: an affine two-chart cover `D` of `C.left`
140	pulls back, along the first projection `(C ⊗ overSpec k R).left ⟶ C.left`, to an affine
141	two-chart cover of `(C ⊗ overSpec k R).left`, for any `k`-algebra `R`. The charts are the
142	preimages of `D`'s charts under the first projection. All four fields follow from `D`'s
143	fields: the first projection is an affine morphism (`Over.isAffineHom_fst_left`, since
144	`overSpec k R ⟶ Spec k` is a morphism between affine schemes hence affine), preimage of an
145	affine open under an affine morphism is affine, and preimage commutes with `⊔`, `⊓`, `⊤`. -/
146	noncomputable def Scheme.AffineTwoCover.pullbackProd (D : C.left.AffineTwoCover)
147	    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Algebra k R] :
148	    (C ⊗ overSpec k R).left.AffineTwoCover where
149	  V₀ := (fst C (overSpec k R)).left ⁻¹ᵁ D.V₀
150	  V₁ := (fst C (overSpec k R)).left ⁻¹ᵁ D.V₁
151	  isAffineOpen₀ := D.isAffineOpen₀.preimage (fst C (overSpec k R)).left
152	  isAffineOpen₁ := D.isAffineOpen₁.preimage (fst C (overSpec k R)).left
153	  sup_eq_top := by
154	    rw [← Scheme.Hom.preimage_sup, D.sup_eq_top, Scheme.Hom.preimage_top]
155	  isAffineOpen_inf := by
156	    rw [← Scheme.Hom.preimage_inf]
157	    exact D.isAffineOpen_inf.preimage (fst C (overSpec k R)).left
158	
159	end PullbackProd
